purpose: A non-destructive, page-by-page description of released Issue 1 that can be paired with current approved character references for regeneration without rewriting the released story or modifying the active Vikings Issue 2+ production data.

regenerationPolicy.storyAndComposition: The released Issue 1 page controls panel count/order, action, geography, props, environmental state, costume state, lettering, captions and editorial design. Do not add, omit, reorder, modernize or reinterpret story content.
regenerationPolicy.characterIdentity: For recurring named characters, use the current approved character references when regenerating. This reconstruction intentionally uses handles/names rather than copying released facial identity descriptions back into the shelf.
regenerationPolicy.incidentalPeople: Incidental one-off people without current character references are described only as needed to reproduce their released function and appearance.
regenerationPolicy.visualLanguage: Ordinary story pages use grounded painted contemporary realism: tactile fur/skin/materials, clear black panel borders, off-white page field, cool gray-blue outdoor light, flat fluorescent municipal interiors, restrained accent colors and natural human acting. Pages 1, 2 and 26 are intentional cover/editorial collateral and are not story-page layout templates.
regenerationPolicy.noMutation: This file is additive reference material only. Existing Vikings characters, settings, regions, issue plans, active page overlays, generation contracts and released Visions assets remain unchanged.

reusableVisuals.northAtlanticLongship: Weathered clinker-built wooden longship with carved animal-head prow, square brown sail, rigging, round shields, wet timber and cramped open deck; materially historical rather than fantasy-ornate.
reusableVisuals.lowerManhattanHarbor: Dense ordinary 2026 Lower Manhattan skyline seen across green-gray harbor water with ferries, patrol/work boats, seawalls and modern port infrastructure.
reusableVisuals.workingPier: Wet concrete/stone industrial waterfront with yellow curbs, rusted crane, warehouse fabric, bollards, grime, shells and gray daylight.
reusableVisuals.dtiTransportVan: Ordinary white/gray municipal cargo-passenger van marked DTI TRANSPORT; mesh partition, gray vinyl bench and utilitarian interior.
reusableVisuals.dtiBuildingExterior: Plain mid-century municipal office slab with gridded concrete facade, fluorescent windows, glass lobby entrance and straightforward departmental sign; no futuristic architecture.
reusableVisuals.dtiIntakeOffice: Cramped underfunded municipal intake room with stained off-white walls, peeling notice boards, beige laminate desk, gray molded chairs, file trays, calculator/computer, paper stacks, cubicle partitions and cool drop-ceiling fluorescents.
reusableVisuals.bushwickRooftop: Tar roof with low brick parapet and bulkhead door, silver turbine vents, rectangular HVAC/vent units, satellite dish, blue plastic milk crate, neighboring brick roofs and broad New York skyline; bright ordinary daytime light.
reusableVisuals.pinkForms: Pink municipal/lease forms recur from DTI intake through the rooftop paperwork sequence; pair with blue/black pens and brown clipboard as applicable.
reusableVisuals.redInkPad: Large rectangular red ink pad used for Bjorn’s thumbprint; red ink visibly transfers to thumb/palm and to the form.
reusableVisuals.fluorescentWristband: Bright fluorescent yellow intake wristband fitted around Bjorn’s wrist beside his metal arm rings.
reusableVisuals.roofDamage: Satellite dish and central-air/vent components are progressively handled, removed and stacked as thin galvanized/aluminum pieces; state accumulates from pages 16 through 25 rather than resetting.
reusableVisuals.silasPhone: Ordinary black contemporary smartphone used vertically to record/document the rooftop incident.

issueVisualState.arrivalWardrobePages1To15: Bjorn remains in the released arrival-state heavy dark green-black coat with large brown fur collar, dark shirt/trousers, gloves, boots and round metal medallion. Gunnar remains in released travel-state fur/leather layers with tan work apron/tunic, forearm wraps, leather leg wraps/boots, round wooden shield when shown, and broad dark charcoal eye paint across the eye area. These are page-specific wardrobe/state cues; current approved character references still control identity.
issueVisualState.carrieWorkState: Carrie wears practical navy DTI outerwear with circular DTI patch, dark gray high-neck layer, practical dark trousers/boots and municipal ID/clipboard as shown. Preserve the released work-state props without reconstructing her face from the old page.
issueVisualState.rooftopPages16To25: Bjorn carries the same arrival coat/medallion state onto the roof. The Kin wear grounded historical fur/leather work clothing. Carrie keeps navy DTI field outerwear, ID and clipboard/forms. Silas appears in ordinary contemporary gray/dark tech-neighbor clothing with clear glasses, slim black pants, sneakers and a smartwatch while filming on an ordinary smartphone.
issueVisualState.gunnarEyePaint: Gunnar visibly carries broad dark charcoal/black eye paint through the arrival/harbor material where it appears in the released page; preserve it as an Issue 1 state even if the current identity portrait is cleaner.
